## Analyzing scRNA-seq data from human tumors

```{r include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(patchwork)
library(future)
library(tidyr)
# library(SoupX)
library(SeuratWrappers)

options(future.globals.maxSize = 3 * 1024^3)  # 3 GB
```

### Read data

```{r}
path <- paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/scRNA/data/raw")

read_data <- Read10X(path)

defar.data <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = read_data, project = "defaria")

read_data <- Read10X(path)

jessa.data <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = read_data, project = "jessa")
 

```

### Preprocess

```{r}
source("~/Projects/etmr/defaria/scripts/functions.R")


obj.list <- list(defaria = defar.data, jessa = jessa.data)

obj.list <- lapply(obj.list, function(x) {
  x[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(x, pattern = "^MT-")

  x <- subset(x, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                         nFeature_RNA < 6000 & 
                         nCount_RNA < 40000 & 
                         percent.mt < 15)
  x <- NormalizeData(x)
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, selection.method = "vst")
  x <- ScaleData(x)
  x <- RunPCA(x, seed.use = 2026)
  x <- FindNeighbors(x, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca")
  x <- FindClusters(x, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "clusters", algorithm = 4, random.seed = 2026)
  x <- RunUMAP(x, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap")
  
  return(x)
})

(DimPlot(obj.list$jessa, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("clusters"), label = TRUE) + ggtitle( "Jessa", subtitle = "Leiden resolution 1")) + (DimPlot(obj.list$defaria, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("clusters"), label = TRUE) + ggtitle("de Faria", subtitle = "Leiden resolution 1") )
```

```{r unint_plots, eval=FALSE}

#These are the previous clusters, don't touch
clus_unint_jessa <- DimPlot(obj.list$jessa,

clus_unint_jessa
```

### Genes

```{r}
cellmarkers <- list(
    "Astrocytes" = c("GFAP", "ALDH1L1", "S100B", "SLC1A2", "ACSL6", "AGT"),
    "Oligodendrocytes" = c("MBP", "MOG", "CLDN14", "NIPAL4", "PLP1", "ERMN", "CLDN14", "KLK6", "EML1"),
    "Oligodendrocyte progenitors" = c("PDGFRA", "ALDOC", "OLIG1", "EPN2", "NEU4", "NKX6-2", "SOX10", "FYN"),
    "Microglia" = c("RGS10", "DLEU7", "CD40", "CD68", "ITGAM", "CX3CR1", "TMEM119"),
    "Ependymal" = c("LIAS", "SPAG6", "CFAP54", "FOXJ1", "RSPH1", "CCDC153"),
    "Neuroblasts" = c("DCX", "NEUROG1", "NCAM1", "NEUROD1"),
    "Neurons (general)" = c("DISP2", "PRPH", "CNTNAP2", "RBFOX3", "NEFM", "NRGN", "SGIP1", "ENO2"),
    "GABA" = c("GAD1", "GAD2", "SLC6A1", "SLC32A1", "DLX1", "GABBR2", "GADD45B", "PAX2"),
    "Glutamatergic" = c("SLC17A6", "SLC17A7", "SLC17A8"),
    "Cycling" = c("TOP2A", "MKI67", "AURKA"),
    "IPC" = c("EOMES", "HES6", "NEUROD4"),
    "RDG" = c("PAX6", "SLC1A3", "PDGFD", "GLI3", "NOTCH3", "VCAM1", "HES5", "CDH4", "SPRY1", "AXIN2", "SOX2", "VIM", "NES")
)
```

### Annotation

```{r jessa_features}
for (x in names(cellmarkers)) {
  obj.list$defaria <- AddModuleScore(
    obj.list$defaria,
    features = cellmarkers[x],
    name = x
  )
}

unint_feat_defar <- FeaturePlot(obj.list$defaria, 
                            features = paste0(names(cellmarkers),"1"), ncol = 4, 
                            reduction = "umap",
                            min.cutoff = 0,
                            max.cutoff = 4,
                            order = TRUE) & scale_color_gradient2(
  low = "blue",     # negative values
  mid = "lightyellow",     # zero
  high = "red",     # positive values
  midpoint = 0,
  limits = c(-1, 3))

ggsave(paste0(here::here(), "/defaria/scRNA/plots/umaps/1/unintegrated/tumors/celltype_plots_defar.png"), unint_feat_defar,height = 8, width = 14, units = "in")

```

## Integration

```{r}
obj.list <- list(defaria = defar.data, jessa = jessa.data)

common.genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(obj.list, rownames))

obj.list <- lapply(obj.list, function(x) {
  subset(x, features = common.genes)
})


merged.data <- merge(
  obj.list$jessa, obj.list$defaria, 
  add.cell.ids = c("jessa", "defaria")
  )

# int.data <- SplitObject(int.data, split.by = "orig.ident")

merged.data <- NormalizeData(merged.data)
merged.data <- FindVariableFeatures(merged.data, selection.method = "vst")
merged.data <- ScaleData(merged.data)
merged.data <- RunPCA(merged.data, seed.use = 2026, reduction.name = "pca_unintegrated")


merged.data <- FindNeighbors(merged.data, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca_unintegrated")
merged.data <- FindClusters(merged.data, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters", algorithm = 4, random.seed = 2026)
merged.data <- RunUMAP(merged.data, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca_unintegrated", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")


DimPlot(merged.data
        , reduction = "umap.unintegrated", group.by = c("orig.ident", "unintegrated_clusters"), label = TRUE)


```

### RPCA

```{r}
int.data <- merged.data

int.data <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = int.data, method = RPCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca_unintegrated", new.reduction = "integrated.rpca",
  verbose = FALSE
)

int.data <- FindNeighbors(int.data, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.rpca")
int.data <- FindClusters(int.data, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "rpca_clusters", algorithm = 4, random.seed = 2026)
int.data <- RunUMAP(int.data, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.rpca", reduction.name = "umap.integrated.rpca", seed.use = 2026)

DimPlot(int.data
        , reduction = "umap.integrated.rpca", group.by = c("orig.ident", "rpca_clusters"), label = TRUE)

DimPlot(int.data
        , reduction = "umap.integrated.rpca", split.by = c("orig.ident"))
```


### MNN

```{r}

int.data <- merged.data


int.data <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = int.data, method = SeuratWrappers::FastMNNIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca_unintegrated", new.reduction = "integrated.mnn",
  verbose = FALSE
)


int.data <- FindNeighbors(int.data, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.mnn")
int.data <- FindClusters(int.data, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "mnn_clusters", algorithm = 4, random.seed = 2026)
int.data <- RunUMAP(int.data, dims = 1:30, reduction = "integrated.mnn", reduction.name = "umap.integrated.mnn", seed.use = 2026)

DimPlot(int.data
        , reduction = "umap.integrated.mnn", group.by = c("orig.ident", "mnn_clusters"), label = TRUE)

DimPlot(int.data
        , reduction = "umap.integrated.mnn", split.by = c("orig.ident"), label = TRUE)


```

```{r}

mnn_type_long <- int.data@meta.data  |>
  rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  dplyr::select(
    cell,
    orig.ident, 
    unintegrated_clusters, 
    mnn_clusters, 
    celltype_mnn, 
    paste0(names(cellmarkers),"1")
    ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(cell, 
              orig.ident, 
              unintegrated_clusters, 
              mnn_clusters, 
              celltype_mnn), names_to = "cell_type"
    )
  
mnn_type_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mnn_clusters, y = value)) +
  geom_violin() +
  facet_wrap(vars(cell_type))

#Split dataframes by cell type to see if there's overlap between the cells 
mnn_type_list <- mnn_type_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type) |>
  group_split() 

mnn_type_list <- setNames(lapply(mnn_type_list, function(x) x |>
  filter(value > .1)
  ), sort(paste0(names(cellmarkers),"1")))

lapply(mnn_type_list, function(x) table(x$celltype_mnn,
      x$cell_type))

lapply(mnn_type_list, function(x) table(x$mnn_clusters,
      x$cell_type))

lapply(mnn_type_list, function(x) table(x$orig.ident,
      x$cell_type))
length(mnn_type_list$Astrocytes1$cell)

length(intersect(mnn_type_list$GABA1$cell, mnn_type_list$Glutamatergic1$cell))
length(setdiff(mnn_type_list$GABA1$cell, mnn_type_list$Glutamatergic1$cell))

length(intersect(mnn_type_list$RDG1$cell, mnn_type_list$Astrocytes1$cell))
length(setdiff(mnn_type_list$RDG1$cell, mnn_type_list$Astrocytes1$cell))

length(intersect(mnn_type_list$Oligodendrocytes1$cell, mnn_type_list$Astrocytes1$cell))
length(setdiff(mnn_type_list$Oligodendrocytes1$cell, mnn_type_list$Astrocytes1$cell))


```
